result.question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior crescimento absoluto de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
result.gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p2.n2 - p1.n1) AS crescimento_absoluto FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY crescimento_absoluto DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH periodo_2008_2012 AS ( SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ), periodo_2019_2023 AS ( SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ) SELECT p2.diagnostico, COALESCE(p2.total_internacoes, 0) - COALESCE(p1.total_internacoes, 0) AS delta_temporal, COALESCE(p2.total_internacoes, 0) AS total_internacoes FROM periodo_2008_2012 p1 FULL OUTER JOIN periodo_2019_2023 p2 ON p1.diagnostico = p2.diagnostico ORDER BY delta_temporal DESC LIMIT 10;
